items.title: Deebo Samuel: Practicing Wednesday
items.text:
Samuel (hamstring) will return to practice Wednesday, David Lombardi of SFStandard reports.

items.title: Mike Evans: Sits out Wednesday's practice
items.text:
Evans (Achilles) was listed as a non-participant in Wednesday's practice, Cam Inman of The San Jose Mercury News reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Carson Beck: Will start Sunday
items.text:
Head coach Mike LaFleur said Wednesday that Beck will start Sunday's game against the Rams, Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Michael Pittman: Not ready to practice
items.text:
Pittman (foot) is making progress but won't have his practice window opened this week, Mike DeFabo of The Athletic reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Davante Adams: Could return by Week 12
items.text:
Coach Sean McVay noted of Adams (hamstring) on Wednesday that he thinks a return to action by the wideout on Nov. 25 against the Packers "is a realistic timeline for us," Greg Beacham of the Associated Press reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
